title: The Wolf of Ironhollow
author: Kestrel Montrose
blurb: Felix Oyelaran, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
